tables.title: TDES0 normal descriptor (write-back format)(1)
tables.text: Table 825, "TDES0 normal descriptor (write-back format)(1)", in section 76.10.3 (Transmit descriptor) on page 4156. Columns: Bit, Name, Description. 1 data row(s). Notes: 1. This format is only applicable to the last descriptor of a packet.

rows:
Transmit Packet Timestamp Low
The DMA updates this field with least significant 32 bits of the timestamp captured 
for the corresponding Transmit packet. The DMA writes the timestamp only if TTSE 
bit of TDES2 is set in the first descriptor of the packet. This field holds the 
timestamp only if the Last Segment bit (LS) in the descriptor is set and the 
Timestamp status (TTSS) bit is set.
notes: 1. This format is only applicable to the last descriptor of a packet.
